prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption: Move sign-in step to occur after pet adoption so users build emotional connection to their chosen pet before creating an account. (why: 72.9% sign-in conversion and long mean time (567s) show early auth friction. Users also report missing pets after sign-in.)
1: [home, wait_info] Estimated Wait Time & Desktop Alerts: Display progress bar, time estimate, and desktop readiness notification options while pet assets generate. (why: Home waiting screen has a huge mean duration (2336s), indicating users abandon or idle during long background generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Clarification: Add an explicit safety warning on sign-in screen informing users how logging in preserves their active pet. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Path Selection Copy: Simplify path options text with direct actions to pick standard pet vs custom generation. (why: Choose path has a huge mean duration of 514s despite a 76.2% conversion rate, indicating user hesitation.)
4: [adoption, layout] Grid Selection Layout for Pick Friend: Switch pick_friend screen layout to a grid view with visual choice cards. (why: Pet selection takes 89s median / 1017s mean and suffers from visual choice confusion.)
5: [finish, notification] Background Notification on Completion: Enable desktop notifications when finishing onboarding so users know when pet drops onto screen. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with 5815s mean time, showing users leave app minimized while waiting.)

scores.note: Addresses high sign-in drop-off (27.1%) and user support reports of lost pet connection.
Mitigates extreme home wait duration (2336s mean) causing idle drop-off.
Directly supported by 8 support complaints and targets sign-in friction at low implementation cost.
Low cost text update to reduce hesitation (514s mean time) on choose_path.
Targets the biggest funnel leak (adoption step at 60.9% conversion) via layout redesign.
Addresses long delay (5815s mean) and drop-off (64.8% conversion) at final step.
